lines.text: Many learners say: How long time do you need?
Better: How long do you need?
How long already asks about time.
Long! How long is the movie?

data.wrong: How long time do you need?
data.why: How long already asks about time.

native.hook: how long 后面不加 time！
native.tip: 中文问“多长时间”，所以容易说 how long time。英语的 how long 已经包含“时间”，不加 time。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “How long time do you need?”😅 how long 已经包含“时间”，后面不加 time：“How long do you need?”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: How long already asks about time, so skip the word time.
en.caption: Do you say “How long time do you need?” 😅 How long already asks about time, so skip the word time: “How long do you need?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
